title: ライブ・ア・ライブ
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

Kana by their order in the font; signs read in play. All 768 kanji (1D00-1FFF) read off sheets of the cartridge's font (yomikata rom-font), once, by one reader, in their readings' order: the 74 read in play agree, and 124 more stood right in 27 sentences decoded from the cartridge
Played from power-on: the openings of three chapters (SF, Bakumatsu, Near Future)
What the script said in play agreed with the lines read off 54 of 54 pictures, over 4 scenes. No screen without text was among them; a question's answers come out as rows of its text
notes: Read by the script games/sfc/SFC-A07624CD.lua. The game keeps no message in work RAM: it draws from the script in the cartridge, and a pointer says where it has got to. So the script reads the cartridge (0xC00000 on) and needs a host that gives it. One byte a character but for kanji (two, from 0x1A to 0x1F); kana by rule, the rest by the table, which has the font's 768 kanji (codes 1D00-1FFF); a code it hasn't got comes out as U+FFFD. Who speaks, menus and fights aren't read.
